attchmntText: Ceinsys Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Ceinsys Tech Limited has submitted the audio recording of its Q2 FY2026-27 earnings call to the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited. The call was held on November 17, 2026, at 11:30 AM IST. It discussed the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The recording is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Ceinsys Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Ceinsys Tech Ltd filed a presentation on Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations for Q2-FY27 was INR 1,595 million, a 2.4 percent year-on-year decline. EBITDA stood at INR 428 million, up 20.2 percent year-on-year, with a margin of 26.8 percent. Profit after tax was INR 326 million, up 26.8 percent year-on-year. Diluted earnings per share were INR 15.58. For H1-FY27, consolidated revenue was INR 3,173 million, a 0.9 percent year-on-year decline. EBITDA was INR 813 million, up 23.6 percent year-on-year. Profit after tax was INR 636 million, up 10.8 percent year-on-year. Diluted earnings per share were INR 30.36. The company incorporated Aastra AI India Private Limited as a joint venture on November 3, 2026. Approval was granted for a wholly owned subsidiary in the UAE.

attchmntText: Ceinsys Tech Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Ceinsys Tech Ltd published its financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, in newspapers on November 14, 2026. Kumar Infraprojects Ltd approved its results at a Board meeting on November 13, 2026. Tata Power Company Limited invited expressions of interest for a tender regarding survey and monitoring of unloading operations for its Robary Thermal Power Plant. India Power Corporation Limited, under resolution professional management, approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Tamil Nadu Newsprint and Papers Limited published its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
